subject: Requisition triage — executive checkpoint for Q1 coverage decisions
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Requisition triage — exec checkpoint for Q1 coverage decisions

Team —

Ahead of the QBR / OKR checkpoint next week I want to lock decisions on the set of open reqs we plan to push vs freeze for Q1. I attached a short coverage model (Q1_role_coverage_model_v3.xlsx) with three scenarios: Baseline (current budget), Stretch (+8 FTE), and Constrained (-6 FTE).

High level asks:
- Can each of you review the highlighted reqs in tab "Critical" and call out any non-negotiable needs by EOD Monday?
- For reqs marked "deferred" I need proposed mitigations (contractor, role consolidation, delay to Q2).
- If you expect headcount spend to shift between revenue and GTM buckets, note it in column H so Finance and People Ops can pre-approve reallocation.

I think we should aim to greenlight no more than 4 new senior IC hires in the constrained case and prioritize backfills for customer-facing CS/infra teams.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure & Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q1_role_coverage_model_v3.xlsx (sheet: Critical reqs), req-redlines-20261129.pdf (redline notes)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Requisition triage — exec checkpoint for Q1 coverage decisions

Markus —

Thanks for the model and clear asks. Quick notes after a run-through of the Critical tab:
- ENG-req-114 (Inference Runtime Engineer): non-negotiable — existing cluster risk if not backfilled. Recommend greenlight in all scenarios.
- ENG-req-131 (Distributed Systems SWE): defer in Constrained; add contractor for 6 months in Constrained scenario.
- CS-req-22 (Customer Success Manager, Enterprise): prioritize for revenue retention — needs to stay in Baseline/Stretch.

I added line comments in the sheet and flagged two reqs for potential leveling up to Staff (cost/impact tradeoff) — see column comments.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Engineering Programs
Redwood Inference

Markus / team —

Quick update from my side after speaking with Recruiting and PeopleOps:
- Recruiting can accelerate ENG-req-114 to an on-site by mid-Jan if we open the req now and approve a hiring panel.
- For CS-req-22 we should consider a 30% variable comp swap to reduce fixed spend in Constrained case; PeopleOps flagged an approval path for this (see Drive note).
- Contractors: TalentBridge (Clara Ortiz) has two senior SRE contractors with prior Redwood infra experience — feel free to loop them if we defer ENG-req-131.

I uploaded a short summary to the Drive folder.

Hannah

Thanks — good input. Two quick decisions from my side so we can brief the Execs:
1) ENG-req-114: Approve immediate open (backfill) — Recruiting to prioritize.
2) ENG-req-131: Defer in Constrained; engage TalentBridge contractors if candidate flow lags.
3) CS-req-22: Approve in Baseline/Stretch. For Constrained scenario, proceed only if we can structure comp as variable; Laura to confirm feasible plan with Sales Finance.

Jonas — can you own a 3-line slide for the QBR that summarizes the approvals + tradeoffs? Need it by Tuesday morning.

Markus
